scope: Standing Intermediate Reservoir Dam, including its lowered north spillway, crest, downstream stilling pool, side walls and rails.
geometryBasis: Mapped 14-point dam outline from way 323624579, including six shared shoreline points with the named Intermediate Reservoir. The government 5 m terrain records the narrow drop below the dam and the adjoining banks.
sectionBasis: Masonry-faced gravity wall, lowered north spillway, concrete stilling-basin sidewalls and tubular steel guards. The downstream bed follows the original topography.
limitations: The published reservoir full water elevation of 58.17 m HKPD was used as the approximate lowered overflow height. The 1977 safety works lowered the north spillway by nine feet. The exact location and lengths of these crest changes are estimates.

The basin edge, depth and guardrails are interpreted from the local grade and written records. No dated water surface is represented. The valve house and its access bridge are reserved for the independent valve-house model.
